title: Wooden Marble Run Sculpture
body_html: A sculptural walnut marble run where steel marbles spiral slowly down a continuous curved track. Part kinetic art, part regulation tool — it holds a room's attention without asking anything of it.

title: Bearing Clicker Fidget Slider
body_html: A machined aluminium slider running on sealed bearings with a brass detent that gives a soft, tactile click. Repeatable, low-noise feedback for hands that need a rhythm to think against.

title: Obsidian Worry Stone Set
body_html: Three hand-polished obsidian worry stones with thumb indentations, in graduated sizes. Cool to the touch, glass-smooth, and discreet enough to use through a conversation without anyone noticing.

title: Brass Spinning Top — Desk Set
body_html: A solid brass precision top with a ceramic bearing tip and a concave black base that keeps it in orbit. Spins for minutes at a time and gives the eye something to settle on mid-thought.

title: Weighted Steel Fidget Cube
body_html: A dense machined stainless fidget cube with buttons, dials and a spinning disc across its faces. Substantial in the palm, completely silent, and pocketable enough to carry into a meeting.

title: Modular Geometric Puzzle — Hardwood
body_html: A hardwood modular puzzle of coloured geometric blocks in a lacquered tray, with no single correct solution. Open-ended composition that rewards a wandering mind rather than punishing it.

title: Magnetic Sphere Constellation Set
body_html: A set of precision neodymium spheres with a chrome finish that build into lattices, chains and shifting sculptures. Tactile, quiet and infinitely reconfigurable — a desk object for hands that need work.

title: Titanium Orbit Pen
body_html: A machined grade-5 titanium pen with a smooth bolt-action mechanism you can work one-handed, indefinitely. Balanced weight, knurl-free barrel and a click quiet enough for a shared office.

title: Kinetic Sand Table — Walnut
body_html: A solid walnut kinetic sand table where a magnetically driven steel ball draws slow patterns in fine sand. Near-silent motor, endlessly varied paths — a moving focal point that soaks up restless attention.

title: Circadian Tunable Desk Lamp
body_html: A slim matte-black desk lamp tuning from 2200K amber to 5000K daylight with flicker-free dimming. Warm and low at night, bright and cold for deep work — light that supports the rhythm rather than fighting it.

title: White Noise Sound Machine
body_html: A single-purpose sound machine with a real mechanical fan tone plus layered pink and brown noise. No screen, no app, one dial — it masks household noise and holds a stable sound floor all night.

title: Blackout Thermal Curtain — Charcoal
body_html: A triple-weave blackout panel in charcoal that blocks effectively all light and dampens outside noise. Thermal lining steadies room temperature and the heavy drape hangs dead straight with no light gaps.

title: Climate Mattress Topper — Dual-Zone Cooling
body_html: An active dual-zone mattress topper that cools or warms each side of the bed independently. Quiet water-circulation, app scheduling, and a genuine fix for anyone whose sleep breaks at the first heat spike.

title: Memory Foam Contour Pillow
body_html: A cervical contour pillow in slow-response memory foam with a ventilated core and a removable bamboo cover. Supports the neck in side and back sleeping and takes the strain out of screen-heavy days.

title: Down-Alternative Pillow — Medium Loft
body_html: A medium-loft pillow filled with microfibre clusters that mimic down without the allergens. Holds shape through the night, cased in cotton percale, and machine washable in a domestic drum.

title: Mulberry Silk Pillowcase 22mm — Charcoal
body_html: 22-momme grade 6A mulberry silk in deep charcoal, with a hidden zip and no exposed seam against the face. Frictionless on skin and hair, and it stays cool through the whole night.

title: Eucalyptus Cloud Comforter — White
body_html: A eucalyptus lyocell comforter with a light down-alternative fill that traps warmth without heat build-up. Naturally moisture-wicking and cool to the touch — built for people who overheat at 2am.

title: French Linen Duvet Set — Stone
body_html: Stonewashed French flax linen in a soft neutral stone, pre-washed for immediate softness. Breathable through summer, insulating in winter, and it only gets better with age and laundering.

title: Percale Duvet Cover — White
body_html: Crisp cotton percale in optic white with a matte, cool finish and a hotel-weight body. Internal corner ties, hidden button closure, and the dry crackle-free hand that sleeps cooler than sateen.

title: 600TC Sateen Sheet Set — Ivory
body_html: Long-staple cotton sateen at 600 thread count in warm ivory, with a cool liquid hand that improves every wash. Deep pockets, elastic all round, and a smooth face with no pilling.

title: Glass Bead Weighted Blanket 9kg
body_html: A 9kg weighted blanket with fine glass beads in a seven-layer quilted shell, sewn in small pockets so the weight never pools. Deep-pressure input that reliably slows the nervous system before sleep.

title: Chunky Knit Weighted Blanket — Asteroid
body_html: A hand-loomed chunky knit throw with weight built from the yarn itself rather than beads. Deep even pressure across the body, breathable open stitch, and no rustle when you move under it.

title: Brogue Derby — Cognac
body_html: A Goodyear-welted derby in cognac calfskin with full brogueing and a leather-stacked heel. Cushioned insole, soft unlined vamp and a resoleable construction that makes it a decade-long shoe.

title: Chunky Court Sneaker — White
body_html: A white leather court sneaker on a chunky cupsole with a padded collar and memory-foam footbed. Wide toe box, no tongue slip, and a break-in period of roughly zero.

title: Diagonal Track Pant — Black
body_html: A tapered track pant in a matte technical jersey with diagonal side detailing. Soft brushed interior, drawcord waist with no dig, and zip hems that clear a shoe without a fight.

title: Fine Wool Trouser — Graphite
body_html: A tailored trouser in fine graphite wool with a hidden elasticated side waist and no scratchy internal curtain. Clean break, no cuff, and enough stretch to sit through a long meeting comfortably.

title: Lambskin Moto Jacket — Onyx
body_html: Butter-soft lambskin in an asymmetric moto cut, fully lined in cupro so it glides over knitwear. The leather is supple from day one — no stiff break-in, no creak, no pressure across the shoulders.

title: Down Puffer — Matte Black
body_html: A matte-black down puffer with a high fill-power baffle construction and a soft-touch shell that doesn't rustle. Warmth without weight, and a hood that packs flat into the collar when it's too much.

title: Wool-Cashmere Overcoat — Camel
body_html: A single-breasted overcoat in a wool-cashmere melton, cut long and clean in camel. Half-canvassed construction gives structure without stiffness, and the satin lining lets it slide on over knitwear.

title: Silk-Linen Tee — Obsidian
body_html: A silk-linen jersey tee in obsidian black with a fluid drape and a dry, cool hand. Bonded hems and a printed neck label mean no scratch points, and the weave breathes through long, warm days.

title: Merino Rollneck — Black
body_html: A heavier-gauge merino rollneck in black with a soft fold collar that sits away from the throat. Fully machine washable, holds shape through repeated wear, and pairs with everything already in the wardrobe.

title: Merino Seamless Turtleneck — Ink
body_html: Whole-garment knitted merino with no side seams at all, in a deep ink navy. Fine-gauge, temperature-regulating and completely smooth against the torso — the closest thing to wearing nothing.

title: Cashmere Crewneck — Ash
body_html: Pure cashmere in a 12-gauge crewneck, knitted in ash grey with ribbed cuffs and hem. Light enough for indoors, warm enough alone under a coat, and completely free of the itch that makes most wool unwearable.

title: Cashmere-Blend Hoodie — Slate
body_html: Cashmere-blend loopback in a muted slate, cut with dropped shoulders and a soft unlined hood. The hand is closer to knitwear than sweatshirting — warm, weightless and quiet against the skin.

title: Heavyweight Fleece Hoodie — Bone
body_html: A 500gsm brushed-back cotton fleece hoodie in bone, garment-washed so it arrives soft with no break-in period. Flat-lock seams, tagless neck and a relaxed body that never grips — built for people who notice every seam.

title: Portable Espresso Maker — Stainless
body_html: A hand-pressurised portable espresso maker in stainless steel and matte black. Nine bars of pressure from a single cylinder, no power required, and a ritual short enough to hold attention.

title: Titanium Smart Ring — Sleep & Recovery Tracker
body_html: A brushed titanium smart ring tracking sleep stages, heart-rate variability and daily readiness. No screen, no buzzing wrist — data waits in the app until you choose to look at it.

title: Bone Conduction Open-Ear Headset
body_html: An open-ear bone conduction headset that leaves the ear canal completely free. Audio through the cheekbone, ambient awareness intact — ideal if in-ear pressure or occlusion is a sensory problem for you.

title: ANC Over-Ear Headphones — Matte Black
body_html: Hybrid active noise cancellation in a matte-black over-ear shell with memory-foam pads and a low clamp force. Built for hours of wear: quiet mode for overwhelm, transparency for when you need the room back.

title: Multi-Styler Hot Air Brush — Ionic
body_html: An ionic hot-air styling brush with multiple heat settings and a cool-shot finish. Dries and shapes in one pass, which keeps the morning routine short and predictable.

title: Ambient Bias Lighting Kit — 65" Screen Sync
body_html: A screen-sync bias lighting kit for displays up to 65 inches. Soft coloured light behind the panel lowers contrast strain in a dark room and makes long evening sessions far easier on the eyes.

title: Percussion Therapy Gun Pro — Brushless
body_html: A brushless percussion massager with five speeds and swappable heads, tuned quiet enough to use while watching something. Deep-tissue pressure for shoulders, calves and lower back after long desk days.

title: Ink Note Tablet 10.3" — Stylus Included
body_html: A 10.3-inch e-ink writing tablet with a paper-textured surface and low-latency stylus. No backlight glare, no notification storm — just a single-purpose surface for notes, sketches and reading long documents without screen fatigue.

title: Oval Crystal Sunglasses — Blue Gradient
body_html: A slim oval frame in crystal-clear acetate with blue gradient lenses and UV400 filtering. Light on the bridge, no pressure points behind the ear, and a silhouette that reads considered rather than loud.

title: Audio Smart Sunglasses — Matte Black Polarized
body_html: Open-ear audio built into a matte-black acetate frame with polarized lenses and full UV400 protection. Take calls and run focus audio without blocking ambient sound — useful when earbuds feel like too much sensory pressure.

title: Iced Hoop Earrings 30mm — Gold Vermeil
body_html: 30mm hoops pavé-set with D-colour VVS moissanite in 925 sterling under 14k gold vermeil. Hinged snap closure, lightweight for their size, and a tester-pass sparkle that reads real at any distance.

title: Halo Eternity Band — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: Channel-set D-colour VVS moissanite runs the full circumference of this eternity band in 925 sterling with 14k gold vermeil. Flush-set stones mean nothing catches on cuffs, pockets or skin.

title: Signet Pinky Ring — 925 Silver Moissanite
body_html: A heirloom-weight pinky ring with a bezel-set 1.5ct D-colour VVS moissanite centre in polished 925 sterling silver. Rounded inner band for comfort, no snagging edges, and a tester-pass stone.

title: Solitaire Pendant 3ct — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: A 3ct D-colour VVS moissanite solitaire in a four-prong basket, hung on a 22-inch rope chain. 925 sterling with 14k gold vermeil and a tester-pass stone with genuine fire under low light.

title: Presidential Iced Bracelet 12mm — Gold Vermeil
body_html: A 12mm presidential-link bracelet, fully iced in D-colour VVS moissanite across 925 sterling with 14k gold vermeil. Substantial weight, hidden fold-over clasp and a mirror-polished underside that sits smooth on skin.

title: Tennis Bracelet 5mm — 925 Silver Moissanite
body_html: A classic 5mm round-cut tennis bracelet, every stone D-colour VVS moissanite in a four-prong 925 sterling setting. Passes an electronic diamond tester. Flexible links lie flat and quiet against the wrist.

title: Iced Miami Cuban Bracelet 10mm — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: The 10mm Cuban bracelet to match the chain: full pavé D-colour VVS moissanite, 925 sterling core, heavy 14k gold vermeil. Box clasp with security latch so it stays put through a full day of movement.

title: Iced Figaro Chain 8mm — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: An 8mm Figaro with alternating long and short links, each iced in D-colour VVS moissanite over 925 sterling and 14k gold vermeil. Passes an electronic diamond tester. Lobster clasp, polished edges, no sharp catch points.

title: Iced Rope Chain 6mm — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: Diamond-cut 6mm rope chain with D-colour VVS moissanite stations set in 925 sterling silver under 14k gold vermeil. Tester-pass brilliance with a lighter, everyday weight for men who want shine without bulk.

title: Iced Cuban Link Chain 12mm — Gold Vermeil Moissanite
body_html: A 12mm Miami Cuban link fully pavé-set with D-colour VVS moissanite over 925 sterling silver with heavy 14k gold vermeil. Passes an electronic diamond tester. Box clasp with double security latch and a weighted, quiet drape that sits flat against the chest.

title: Magnetic Thinking Putty
body_html: Iron-infused silicone putty that bends, stretches, and snaps to its included neodymium magnet. Endless tactile loop.

title: ONO Magnetic Slider
body_html: Two brushed-titanium magnetic discs that orbit each other in your palm. Silent, weighted, deeply pocketable. The fidget you'll lose to your partner.

title: Sisyphus Sand Table
body_html: A walnut-rimmed coffee table sand machine. A hidden magnet drags a steel sphere through fine sand, drawing endless geometric mandalas. Quiet motor, brass dial, white-noise calm.

title: Garnet Hill Heated Mattress Pad
body_html: Garnet Hill heated mattress pad with dual zones, 10 heat settings, auto-shutoff. Genuine.

title: Avocado Green Latex Mattress Topper
body_html: Avocado Green organic latex mattress topper, GOLS-certified, naturally cooling. 2" thick. Genuine.

title: Tempur-Pedic Neck Contour Pillow
body_html: Tempur-Pedic memory foam pillow, ergonomic neck contour, hypoallergenic cover. Genuine.

title: Parachute Waffle Cotton Robe — Bone
body_html: Parachute waffle robe in long-staple Turkish cotton, plush ribbed texture, dual deep pockets. Genuine.

title: Frette Hotel Classic Linen Sheet Set — Stone
body_html: Frette Hotel Classic linen sheet set, stonewashed European flax, soft drape. Includes flat sheet, fitted sheet, two pillowcases. Genuine.

title: Garmin fēnix 8 AMOLED — 51mm Titanium
body_html: Garmin fēnix 8 multisport GPS watch with AMOLED display, dive computer, built-in flashlight, solar charging. Genuine.

title: Roborock S8 Pro Ultra Robot Vacuum + Mop
body_html: Roborock S8 Pro Ultra robot vacuum and mop with auto-empty, self-wash, self-refill dock, LiDAR navigation. Genuine.

title: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max — 256GB Titanium Black
body_html: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max with A18 Pro chip, 6.9" Super Retina XDR ProMotion display, 48MP Fusion camera, 256GB. Genuine.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra — 512GB Titanium Black
body_html: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra with Snapdragon 8 Elite, 200MP camera, 6.9" Dynamic AMOLED 2X, S Pen, 512GB. Genuine.

title: Steam Deck OLED — 1TB
body_html: Steam Deck OLED handheld with 7.4" HDR OLED display, 90Hz, custom AMD APU, 1TB SSD. Genuine.

title: Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker — Black
body_html: Bose SoundLink Max portable Bluetooth speaker with custom transducers, 20-hour battery, USB-C audio. Genuine.

title: Sony Alpha 7 IV Mirrorless Camera — Body
body_html: Sony Alpha 7 IV mirrorless camera with 33MP full-frame sensor, 4K 60p video, body only. Genuine.

title: DJI Mavic 4 Pro Drone
body_html: DJI Mavic 4 Pro foldable drone with Hasselblad 4/3 CMOS, 6K/60fps, 51-minute flight time, OcuSync 4. Genuine.

title: Apple Vision Pro — 256GB
body_html: Apple Vision Pro spatial computer with dual micro-OLED displays, M2 + R1 chips, EyeSight, 256GB. Genuine.

title: Sony PlayStation 5 Pro — 2TB
body_html: Sony PlayStation 5 Pro console with enhanced GPU, AI upscaling, 2TB SSD, 8K-ready. Genuine.

title: Apple MacBook Pro 14" M4 Pro — 24GB / 512GB
body_html: Apple MacBook Pro 14" with M4 Pro chip, 24GB unified memory, 512GB SSD, Liquid Retina XDR display. Genuine.

title: Apple iPad Pro 13" M4 — 256GB Wi-Fi
body_html: Apple iPad Pro 13" with M4 chip, Ultra Retina XDR tandem-OLED display, Wi-Fi, 256GB. Genuine.

title: Apple Watch Ultra 2 — 49mm Titanium
body_html: Apple Watch Ultra 2 with titanium case, 49mm, Action Button, dual-frequency GPS, up to 36hr battery. Genuine.

title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones — Black
body_html: Sony WH-1000XM5 wireless over-ear headphones with industry-leading noise cancellation, 30hr battery, LDAC hi-res audio. Genuine.

title: Apple AirPods Pro 2 — USB-C
body_html: Apple AirPods Pro 2 with USB-C, active noise cancellation, Adaptive Audio, MagSafe charging case. Genuine.

title: BC Shawl Silk Cardigan — Heather Grey
body_html: Silk-cashmere blend shawl-collar cardigan in the Brunello Cucinelli mold — luxurious 12-gauge knit, ribbed shawl that rolls beautifully, mother-of-pearl buttons, ribbed cuffs and hem. Relaxed fit, sits at the hip. True to size; size up if you'll layer over a button-down. Fabric: 70% silk / 30% cashmere. Sensory notes: cool-warm hand, itch-free, no neck tag.

title: TF Knit Polo — Forest Green
body_html: Knit polo in mercerized cotton inspired by the Tom Ford rib-collar polo — fine 16-gauge gauge, ribbed three-button placket, slim trim fit. Lustrous finish that dresses up under tailoring or down with denim. Fits close to body; size up if you prefer a relaxed drape. Fabric: 100% mercerized cotton. Sensory notes: soft cool hand, flat shoulder seams, low-friction collar.

title: BR Poplin Dress Shirt — White
body_html: Italian-made cotton-poplin dress shirt modeled on the Brioni house cut — semi-spread collar, hidden placket, mother-of-pearl buttons, single-needle French seams, split yoke. Tailored fit through chest and waist. Order true to neck size; sleeve length is regular. Fabric: 100% long-staple cotton poplin. Sensory notes: smooth flat seams, removable collar stays, no scratchy interfacing.

title: PR Saffiano Leather Messenger Bag — Black
body_html: Structured Saffiano leather messenger bag with adjustable webbing strap, leather top handle and a padded internal sleeve sized for a 15-inch laptop. Two front zip compartments, magnetic flap closure. Crosshatched Saffiano finish resists scratches and rain. One size. Body: 100% Saffiano calfskin leather; lining: 100% nylon twill. Dimensions: 38 × 28 × 10 cm.

title: HM Constance Buckle Belt — Black / Gold
body_html: Pebbled calfskin leather belt with a brushed metal H-buckle, modeled on the Hermès Constance. 35mm width — sits cleanly in the loops of suit trousers and a five-pocket jean alike. Size by waistband measurement in cm (size = your trouser waist + 5cm). Strap: 100% calfskin leather; buckle: brass with gold-tone plating. Reversible-style finish, hand-burnished edges.

title: SL Wyatt Chelsea Boot — Black Calfskin
body_html: Calfskin leather Chelsea boot in the Saint Laurent Wyatt silhouette — sleek almond toe, elastic side gussets, pull-tab heel, slim Cuban-stacked leather sole. Italian construction, hand-finished edges. Fits true to size; narrow foot may prefer a half-size down. Upper: 100% calfskin leather; sole: leather with rubber toplift. Pairs with the SL Wool Tuxedo Trouser or AMI Selvedge Jean.

title: PR Re-Nylon Bomber — Black
body_html: Technical recycled-nylon bomber jacket modeled on the Prada Re-Nylon — full two-way zip, ribbed knit collar, cuffs and hem, snap flap pockets. Lightweight, water-repellent, packs without creasing. Fits true to size with a slightly cropped, modern length. Shell: 100% regenerated nylon; lining: 100% nylon; rib: 95% wool / 5% elastane. Sensory notes: smooth-glide YKK zips, no scratchy interior.

title: BV Box Tee — Black
body_html: Heavyweight 240gsm cotton box tee with dropped shoulders, low-profile neck stitch and a relaxed boxy hem — inspired by the Bottega Veneta tee. Garment-washed for a soft, broken-in hand from day one. Wears oversized; size down for a fitted look. Fabric: 100% combed cotton jersey. Sensory notes: tagless print, ultra-soft hand, no side seams to twist.

title: BB Triple-S Chunky Sneaker — White / Grey
body_html: Oversized dad-shoe sneaker on a stacked multi-layer sole, cut to the Balenciaga Triple S silhouette. Mesh and leather upper, vintage-effect midsole, contrast lacing system. Heavy on foot but cushioned and stable. Runs large — we recommend going a half-size down from your usual sneaker size. Upper: leather/mesh/polyurethane; sole: rubber. Sensory notes: padded ankle, no internal hot-spots.

title: BC Double-Breasted Wool Blazer — Charcoal
body_html: Italian-made Super 120s wool double-breasted blazer in the Brunello Cucinelli mold — peak lapel, six-button stance, half-canvas construction, soft Neapolitan shoulder. Fully lined in cupro for a clean slip over knitwear. Tailored fit; order your jacket size, allow a quarter-size up if you'll layer over a turtleneck. Fabric: 100% virgin wool; lining: 100% cupro. Pairs with the SL Wool Tuxedo Trouser.

title: AMI Selvedge Straight Jean — Raw Indigo
body_html: Triple-stitched 14oz selvedge denim jean cut to the AMI Paris straight silhouette — raw indigo, mid-rise, straight leg through the thigh and knee, finished with a raw hem you can chain-stitch to length. Premium Japanese-style selvedge takes a beautiful fade with wear. Order true to waist; hem is intentionally long. Fabric: 100% cotton selvedge denim. Sensory notes: low-profile rivets, soft tonal pocket bags.

title: SL Wool Tuxedo Trouser — Black
body_html: Pleated wide-leg wool tuxedo trouser in the Saint Laurent line — high-rise, satin grosgrain side stripe, hook-and-bar closure with extended waistband tab. Tailored Italian Super 110s wool drapes cleanly without static cling. Order true to waist; runs long for a clean break over a Chelsea boot. Fabric: 100% virgin wool; lining: 100% cupro. Pair with the Brioni Poplin Shirt for a complete evening look.

title: AS Mock Leather Moto Jacket — Black Lambskin
body_html: Cropped lambskin moto jacket cut to the Acne Studios Mock silhouette. Buttery pebbled lambskin shell, asymmetric two-way zip, polished silver hardware, and a bonded twill lining that skims the skin without scratch. Tailored shoulders, slightly cropped hem, fits true to size — size up for a relaxed layered look. Fabric: 100% lambskin leather; lining: 100% viscose. Sensory notes: no metal-on-skin seams, quiet zip pulls.

title: DT Mach Aviator — Black Titanium / Gold
body_html: Oversized aviator inspired by the Dita Mach series. Black titanium frame, gold accents, gradient grey lenses, 100% UV. Premium replica.

title: RB Wayfarer Acetate — Black / G-15 Polarized
body_html: Classic Wayfarer-style frame in glossy black acetate with G-15 green polarized lenses, 100% UV. High-end replica of the timeless icon.
